verdict.rationale: Mirrors' own npm SDK runs inside the agent's code with no UI: it captures in the background and appends matched corrections to system prompts (mirrors-docs-27, -22, -23, -21). The docs also say 'you or your coding agent' can write and activate corrections (mirrors-docs-28), which hints at non-UI operation of the product's workflow. However, nothing documents running Mirrors itself headlessly or in CI, and probes found no OpenAPI spec or docs.md (mirrors-probe-2, -3). missing for 10: documented CLI or headless mode, CI/pipeline integration (e.g. running correction previews or holdout checks in CI), public API spec, explanation of how coding agents author and activate corrections programmatically, independent corroboration.
